title: Eddy modulation of the subsurface chlorophyll maximum
query: Using the supplied CMOMS daily chlorophyll, temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020, test the following findings of Xu et al. (2023, Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences, doi:10.1029/2023JG007648) on how mesoscale eddies modulate the subsurface chlorophyll maximum (SCM) in the South China Sea: (1) cyclonic eddies uplift the thermocline and anticyclonic eddies depress it; (2) anticyclonic eddies deepen the SCM and reduce its magnitude, while cyclonic eddies make it shallower and stronger; (3) SCM thickness decreases in cyclonic eddies and increases slightly in anticyclonic eddies; (4) the effects grow with eddy amplitude and are largest near eddy centres. State how you detect eddies and define the SCM, give a verdict for each finding (reproduced, partly reproduced, not reproduced, or not testable with the supplied data) with quantitative evidence, and explain differences from the paper, which used a different model and period.

paper.title: Mesoscale Eddy Modulation of Subsurface Chlorophyll Maximum Layers in the South China Sea
